# anatembea

*anatembea* is a tool for AnteNatal Assessment of Temporal malaria
Epidemiology using Mechanistic models, Bayesian Estimation, and
Analysis, an open-source R package, which translates monthly malaria
prevalence collected at first antenatal clinic visit (ANC1) into
seasonal patterns in malaria transmission and clinical cases. Our
framework is underpinned by an established mechanistic model of malaria
dynamics, providing the basis for simulating data-informed hypothetical
scenarios to evaluate the likely impact of alternative intervention
approaches.

For more information, see the published article in *The Lancet Microbe*:
<https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2666524726000704>

## Installation

You can install the development version of *anatembea* from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("mrc-ide/anatembea")
library(anatembea)
```

## Reproducibility for accepted ANC pMCMC manuscript

The current package continues to develop beyond the published analysis.
The exact package state used for that work remains preserved at the
`v1.0-paper` tag.

The analyses were run with R 4.4 using this frozen package state. To
install the paper version, use:

``` r

remotes::install_github("mrc-ide/anatembea@v1.0-paper")
```

Key package versions used in the manuscript workflow included:

- `odin` 1.5.11
- `dust` 0.15.3
- `mcstate` 0.9.22

Analysis scripts and workflow are available at:
<https://github.com/jt-hicks/anc_pmcmc_pub>

## Usage

For an example implementation, check out the vignette at
<https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/articles/anatembea_intro.html>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`admin_match()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/admin_match.md)
  : match admin region
- [`check_seasonality()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/check_seasonality.md)
  : Function that returns values from optional seasonal deterministic
  model
- [`compare_ancall()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/compare_ancall.md)
  : Compare function to calculate likelihood
- [`compare_flex()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/compare_flex.md)
  : Compare function to calculate likelihood when fitting to a flexible
  age group
- [`compare_mg()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/compare_mg.md)
  : Compare function to calculate likelihood
- [`compare_pg()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/compare_pg.md)
  : Compare function to calculate likelihood
- [`compare_pgmg()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/compare_pgmg.md)
  : Compare function to calculate likelihood
- [`compare_u5()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/compare_u5.md)
  : Compare function to calculate likelihood
- [`data_informed()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/data_informed.md)
  : Transformation function that calculates initial values for
  stochastic model
- [`data_process()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/data_process.md)
  : Process raw data for use in pMCMC
- [`data_sim`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/data_sim.md)
  : Non-specific simulated data
- [`equilibrium_init_create_stripped()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/equilibrium_init_create_stripped.md)
  : Equilibrium initialisation list creation
- [`format_na()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/format_na.md)
  : Change missing data to 0s so dbinom function returns 0 (instead of
  NA)
- [`get_anc_from_u5()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/get_anc_from_u5.md)
  : Return ANC prevalence given prevalence in \<5 year old children
- [`get_init_EIR()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/get_init_EIR.md)
  : Return an initial EIR based on a user-given target prevalence in \<5
  year old children
- [`get_odds_from_prev()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/get_odds_from_prev.md)
  : Converts probability (prevalence) to log-odds
- [`get_prev_from_log_odds()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/get_prev_from_log_odds.md)
  : Converts log-odds to probability (or prevalence)
- [`initialise()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/initialise.md)
  : Estimate the initial state given user inputs
- [`load_file()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/load_file.md)
  : load_file
- [`match_clean()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/match_clean.md)
  : match clean
- [`model_param_list_create()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/model_param_list_create.md)
  : Model Parameter List Creation
- [`run_pmcmc()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/run_pmcmc.md)
  : Run a pMCMC
- [`sim_data_tanzania`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/sim_data_tanzania.md)
  : Tanzania site simulated data
- [`transform_init()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/transform_init.md)
  : transform final state of a seasonal model into the initial state of
  a stochastic model
- [`user_informed()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/anatembea/reference/user_informed.md)
  : Transformation function that calculates initial values for
  stochastic model
